name: Plume USD
oneLiner: pUSD is Plume's dollar stablecoin minted 1:1 against USDC in a Nucleus BoringVault; zero-fee redemption on Ethereum or Plume Chain with OFAC compliance checks.
collateral: 1:1 backed by USDC and USDT deposited into a Nucleus BoringVault; USD1 and AUSD also approved as collateral
pegMechanism: Zero-fee mint/redeem at 1:1 for USDC on Ethereum or Plume Chain; reserves managed by Nucleus BoringVault contracts with OFAC compliance checks

mintAuthority.summary: pUSD is minted 1:1 against USDC through a Plume-managed Nucleus BoringVault; the Teller predicate proxy gates each mint with an off-chain OFAC compliance check, and a Manager/Strategist controls vault assets.

controls.label: Nucleus BoringVault Teller (predicate proxy, OFAC-gated mint)
controls.evidence: pUSD minting runs through TellerWithMultiAssetSupportPredicateProxy, which requires an off-chain OFAC/compliance message before minting BoringVault shares; the BoringVault is managed by Plume.

controls.label: BoringVault Manager / Strategist (Plume-controlled)
controls.evidence: The Manager assigns merkle-root-bounded strategist permissions and the vault grants the Teller mint/burn rights; Plume controls the privileged roles that admit minters and deploy backing.

review.evidence: Plume docs and the Nucleus BoringVault framework describe pUSD as a USDC wrapper minted via a Teller predicate proxy with an OFAC compliance predicate, backed 1:1 in a Plume-managed BoringVault; mint is gated and issuer-controlled rather than permissionless or user-collateralized.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the live Teller/Manager owner addresses (multisig vs EOA) and the predicate proxy admin before raising confidence.
